decisions.decision: Do not treat the modern missing-Resources form as automatically producer-invalid. EC3 #292 makes independence a requirement only from PDF 2.0; before that it is strongly recommended. The 1.1-and-earlier statement was demoted to informative note. The PDF 1.7 no-Resources assertion witnesses a compatibility choice, not a universal normative fallback obligation.
decisions.current_code: draw_xobject falls back to page_resources whenever form Resources is absent, and does not use invoker resources. Explicit form Resources remains authoritative.
decisions.verdict: Keep compatibility behavior; no confirmed defect. Do not test mandatory rejection for PDF 2.0 omission absent a distinct reader duty.

decisions.decision: Table 93 contains rendering entries and descriptive/metadata entries. Core rendered behavior (BBox, Matrix, Resources, Group, OC) has owner assertions; Ref, AF, structure keys and metadata have separate consumers/owner shards. Optional OPI/Measure/PtData/PieceInfo/LastModified do not become screen-rendering requirements merely because their table cells exist.
evidence: transparency_groups.rs group subtype and BBox assertions
decisions.verdict: No additional valid, in-scope missing consumer was established in this bounded pass. Existing global B29 is not duplicated; it concerns Form StructElem accessibility-attribute propagation, not this Table 93 review.
